description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, Douglas Ell shares the moment everything began to change — when he realized something felt off and started questioning the path he was on.

As an MIT graduate, he didn’t rely on emotion alone. He wanted evidence.

So he started looking.

And what he found challenged everything he once believed — leading him to the conclusion that the evidence for God was stronger than he expected.

It’s a reminder that asking questions doesn’t weaken your faith — it can actually lead you closer to the truth.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, real-life perspectives, and meaningful discussions.
